notes:
- For streamers: sign in to Twitch, then say "tell chat ...", "shout out ...", "title ...", "category ..."
- Captions on stream: a caption overlay for OBS, and a switch that sends what you say to Twitch chat
- Twitch moderation by voice: "timeout ...", "ban ...", "unban ...", and "approve" / "deny" for messages AutoMod holds
notes_more:
- Friends' Saybox links show On more reliably (they used up ntfy's free daily limit)
- The Remote light turns red and says why when your remote link can't connect
- Translate others: what other players say shows in English on your screen and SteamVR panel (Voice > Other players)
- "Remind me at 9 pm to ..." works, and timers and reminders now survive closing Saybox
- The loading screen can be dragged around, and it smoothly grows into the Saybox window
- "Ruby, pin ..." keeps a line at the top of your chatbox ("unpin" takes it away)
- Quick phrases: "Ruby, save phrase brb as be right back", then just say "Ruby, brb"
- Streamers: "Ruby, clip that" makes a Twitch clip (sign in to Twitch again once)
- If the local AI crashes, Saybox restarts it and still answers your question
- Home shows your last session: how long, messages, commands and any problems
- SteamVR panel: scroll back through your last 30 lines with the thumbstick or the red bar
- Soft sci-fi sounds as you click around, Start and Stop (turn off: Settings > Window sounds)
- What's new now lists every change
